base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())

        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        return self.run_dir
evidence.reason: At the tip, `claim_run_dir` creates the record base and the new run directory, then returns without persisting the new `record_dir/run-*` directory entry. The `durable_write` for `recovery-receipt.json` makes the receipt and its containing run directory durable, but not the parent `record_dir` entry. After host state changes, a power loss can therefore lose the run directory and its recorded prior SHA/trigger state, defeating the recovery evidence. The smallest compatible fix is to sync `base` after `self.run_dir.mkdir(...)` (and `base.parent` if `base` was newly created) and fail closed before proceeding to admission.
